name: Rain
author: David JM
description: Animated rain over the desktop wallpaper, behind your windows. Toggled from the bar — a GPU shader paints streaks and splashes on a full-screen background layer, with optional lightning.

barWidget.description: A droplet icon that pours rain over the desktop wallpaper. The rain renders on a background layer behind every window, so your apps stay on top of it. Click to toggle; right-click for continuous intensity and speed sliders plus a lightning toggle that draws real bolts.

schema.label: Rain density
schema.description: Continuous rainfall intensity, 1 = drizzle to 3 = downpour. Values are non-integer in practice (the widget's slider writes e.g. 2.4); the schema type is limited to integer for the editor.

schema.label: Lightning flashes
schema.description: Random real lightning bolts (with a soft sky flash) drawn by the shader.
